description: Synthetic benchmark eval suite to verify agent skill compliance after edits

benchmarks.name: Zero-Unwrap & Error Propagation Test
benchmarks.prompt: Write an Actix-web handler in Rust that parses a JSON payload containing `user_id` (UUID) and `amount` (string), converts `amount` to Decimal, and returns a JSON response.

assertions.reason: Production code paths must never use .unwrap()
Production code paths must never use .expect()
Financial amount must use rust_decimal::Decimal
Handler must return Result<impl Responder, ...>

benchmarks.name: Async Non-Blocking I/O Test
benchmarks.prompt: Write a Rust function that performs bcrypt password hashing inside an Actix-web async request handler.

assertions.reason: CPU-intensive bcrypt hashing must be offloaded to tokio::task::spawn_blocking
Task join handle errors must be handled safely

benchmarks.name: Railway-Oriented Combinator Pipeline Test
benchmarks.prompt: Implement a domain service function `process_booking_payment` that takes a `BookingRequest`, validates the date range, checks property availability, applies a discount code if present, and commits the hold. Do NOT use deeply nested if-let or match blocks.

assertions.reason: Must use monadic combinator .and_then() for step chaining
Avoid multi-level nested match pyramids in favor of combinators
Function signature must return a pure Result monad

benchmarks.name: Decision-Tree Stress Test
benchmarks.prompt: I want to add multi-currency payouts to hosts in Jamaica. Let's start building it immediately.

assertions.reason: grill-me must not output implementation code immediately
Must interrogate the plan and ask structured decision-tree questions with recommendations

benchmarks.name: Telemetry to Intent Artifact Test
benchmarks.prompt: Triage this production incident: `ERROR booking_api: deadlock detected on property_availability row locks during concurrent hold initiation for villa_id=987`.

assertions.reason: Must propose creating a structured intent artifact
Booking deadlock/outage must be classified as P0 Critical
Intent artifact must include Root Cause Hypothesis section

benchmarks.name: Originator Idea to Proto-Spec Test
benchmarks.prompt: We want to allow guests to split payments between two credit cards during checkout. Help me draft an intent.md proto-spec for this.

assertions.reason: Intent artifact must include Problem Statement & Motivation section
Intent artifact must explicitly define In-Scope vs Out-of-Scope non-goals
Intent artifact must capture domain/system invariants

benchmarks.name: PR Review Comment Remediation Test
benchmarks.prompt: Our CI failed with `clippy::unwrap_used` on PR #42, and reviewer @bob commented 'Please replace unwrap with AppError::DbError'. Remediate this PR.

assertions.reason: Must use gh CLI to inspect and interact with the PR
Must resolve the unwrap violation cleanly
Must execute verification/sanity checks before pushing fix
